## Chimera

BlackPANDA is now Chimera.

- New name and icon across the app, installer, desktop shortcut and download page.
- One START / STOP toggle replaces the old separate buttons.
- The installer removes the old BlackPANDA install, Start Menu entry and desktop shortcut, then installs under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Chimera.
- Settings, offsets and logs migrate to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Chimera.
- A one-time note appears after the update and never returns.
- Farming, ESP, aquarium, custom rods, hotkeys and telemetry are unchanged.
